name: v2 T=2 stagewise protocol (locked, v1.1)

pipeline.flags_note: stage2_update_mode=frozen, adv_norm_scope and continuation_action_mode take effect only in Phase B (after the freeze); Phase A trains stage 2 alone with all rows normalized and stochastic actions

phase_A.lr: constant 0.0003 for local updates 1-1200, then linear 0.0003 -> 3e-05 over local 1201-1600

pipeline.freeze: frozen stage-2 snapshot = deep copy of the actor at the end of Phase A (B2 machinery; no grad, no optimizer)

phase_B.opponent: lagged copy of the actor, refreshed every 20 global updates

pipeline.lr_form: lr(j) = start + (end - start) * (j - local_first) / (local_last - local_first), applied to actor and critic before each update, constant within an update, Adam state preserved (run/run_final_dp_br_round3_dense.py:lr_at, kind 'linear'; run/run_v2_stagewise.py:Run.lr_for)
pipeline.evaluated_candidate: last iterate, Beta mean: stage 2 at the end of A (frozen), stage 1 at the end of B
unchanged: RNG streams and samplers (numpy PCG64 streams from SeedSequence([seed, q, namespace]))
on-path rule: open interval |d - drift| < 2q with exact cell masses
e~1 residual-band method on the final tier
outputs: manifest.json (commit, clean-tree flag, protocol SHA-256, q, seed)
gateA_{final,development}.npz, final_{final,development}.npz, drift_test.json, induced_band.json + sweep NPZ
gates.json (v1.1): G-A, G-F, G-N, run_pass, S1, v1_0_outcome, global_rng, protocol_version 1.1

G-A.candidate: stage-2 last iterate (Beta mean of the live actor at global u1600)

all_must_hold.definition: eta_2 / DW = max over the full final-tier D_2 grid of the one-step deviation gap Delta_2(d), divided by DW (utils.dp_br_verifier.verify -> full_delta_max[2]; utils.v2_metrics.evaluate scalar 'eta_T_over_dw')

sqrt(mean over the recovery grid nodes with |d| < 2q of (e_hat_2(d) - e2*(d))^2) / e2*(0); recovery grid = symmetric grid on D_2 with step 'recovery_step' = 0.5 (utils.v2_metrics.recovery_metrics; independent of the verifier tier)
mean of e_hat_2(d) over the recovery grid nodes with |d| >= 2q, divided by e2*(0) (utils.v2_metrics.recovery_metrics; independent of the verifier tier)

G-F.candidate: full last iterate: live actor at t=1 (global u2200), frozen stage-2 snapshot at t=2

all_must_hold.definition: max over stages t and final-tier grid nodes d of G_t(d) = V_t^BR(d) - V_t^mean(d), divided by DW (utils.v2_metrics.evaluate scalar 'Gmax_full_over_dw')

gates.run_outcome: pass iff G-A, G-F and G-N all pass; a run failing G-A is a stage-2 failure: its Phase B is still executed and reported, and the run counts as failed; a run with a global-RNG violation (hardening) or any nonzero exit counts as failed
gates.dev_tier: G-A and G-F use the final tier; G-N compares development and final tier; every gate and reported metric is also reported on the development tier

G-N.stage: end of Phase A (eta_2) and end of Phase B (Gmax_full)

all_must_hold.definition: |eta_T_over_dw(development) - eta_T_over_dw(final)| of the G-A candidate at the end of Phase A
|Gmax_full_over_dw(development) - Gmax_full_over_dw(final)| of the G-F candidate at the end of Phase B

gates.comparison: every '<=' is inclusive; values compared at full float64 precision, no rounding

stage2: smoothed_share_peak_gap_d0 (Pilot-1 method: 400 equal-probability nodes per Beta at d=0)
stage1_and_full: stage-1 decomposition: learning (e_hat_1 - e~1)/e1*, inherited (e~1 - e1*)/e1*, with residual bands
reported_not_gated.numerics: dev-tier minus final-tier difference of every gate and reported metric

peak_error: not gated; reported with its decomposition (smoothed-game share; Pilot 4 section 1d floor)

stage1_decomposition.method: e~1 = argmin_e Delta_1(e; e_hat_2) on the final tier, band = {e: Delta_1 <= min + floor}
stage1_decomposition.floor: max(Delta_1(e1*; e2*) on the final tier, 1e-12 DW)
stage1_decomposition.sweep_range: anchored at e1*, covering [min(0.4 e1*, e_hat_1 - 2), max(1.7 e1*, e_hat_1 + 2)]

confirmation.status: pre-registered; executed in the v1.1 round only if the v1.1 re-rehearsal checks R1-R6 all pass
confirmation.disjointness_check: tools/v2/seed_inventory.py -> results/v2_T2_locked/consolidation/seed_inventory.csv (0 collisions among 263 recorded seed values)
confirmation.pass_rule: for each q, at least 18 of 20 runs pass (G-A and G-F and G-N); the confirmation passes iff both q pass; each q's pass rate is reported with an exact Clopper-Pearson 95% CI
confirmation.reporting: every run is reported, failures included; nothing changes after the lock
confirmation.crash_rule: infrastructure kill (OOM, disk full, process killed): move the run directory to confirmation/crashed/q{q}/seed{s}_attempt1/ and re-run once into the original path; a second infrastructure failure stops the round and that run is not counted either way; any other nonzero exit (pipeline exception, global-RNG violation) counts as a failed run

50.action_mapping: e = e_min + a (e_max - e_min); a ~ Beta(mu c, (1-mu) c)
50.mean_extraction: e_hat = e_min + (e_max - e_min) alpha/(alpha+beta) in float64 from float32 alpha,beta
50.action_sampling: numpy float64 Beta; clamp [1e-6,1-1e-6]; store float32; old/new log-prob on stored action

60.action_mapping: e = e_min + a (e_max - e_min); a ~ Beta(mu c, (1-mu) c)
60.mean_extraction: e_hat = e_min + (e_max - e_min) alpha/(alpha+beta) in float64 from float32 alpha,beta
60.action_sampling: numpy float64 Beta; clamp [1e-6,1-1e-6]; store float32; old/new log-prob on stored action

training_relevant_state.decided: 2026-10-02, owner decision D1 of the v1.1 round (reports/v2/protocol_lock_and_rehearsal.md, addendum)

global_rng_hardening.seeding: at the start of the pipeline function (run_v2_T2_locked.run_pipeline), before any object is constructed: torch.manual_seed(seed), np.random.seed(seed), random.seed(seed) with the run seed; seeds recorded in the manifest
global_rng_hardening.reference_state: each RNG's state immediately before the first Phase A update (Run.phase_start_hook at phase A); the post-seed state is also recorded, with whether anything between seeding and the reference drew from each RNG
global_rng_hardening.assertion: each of the three states equals its reference state at every assertion point
global_rng_hardening.on_violation: record the RNG and the point in gates.json; the run finishes and writes all outputs, then the entry point exits with a nonzero code (5); the run counts as failed
global_rng_hardening.digests: SHA-256 of each RNG state at seeding, at the reference point and at each assertion point, in the manifest
global_rng_hardening.training: no change to training-relevant state (checked by the re-rehearsal R1)
